payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies KAR as an end-to-end MRC model that integrates general knowledge to enhance its attention mechanisms.

claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end MRC model that explicitly uses general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR integrates neural networks with general knowledge to improve performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art MRC models.
KAR employs knowledge aided mutual attention and knowledge aided self attention as its key attention mechanisms.
